apple.name: Esha by Korlix
apple.subtitle: Beauty routines, made personal
apple.promotional_text: Build your beauty routine around your budget. Explore sourced products, save your favorites and create illustrated looks with Esha by Korlix.
apple.description:
Make room for your own kind of beauty. Esha by Korlix brings product discovery, budget-based routines and illustrated looks together in one membership app.

ESHA MEMBERSHIP
An active Esha trial or paid membership is required for product browsing, the routine planner, your vanity, the look studio and AI consultations. Eligible subscribers get 3 days free, then US $4.99 per month. The App Store shows the actual local price and offer available to you before purchase. Installing Esha or creating an account does not start a trial.

DISCOVER AND PLAN
Explore a starter catalog of makeup, lipstick, lip gloss, lashes, body wash and lotion. Read sourced product details and open manufacturer pages to check current sizes, shades, prices and availability. Build a routine around your preferences, new-product budget and products you already own. Prices are dated estimates before tax and shipping. Unknown prices show Check price and never count as free in a shopping budget.

KEEP YOUR VANITY TOGETHER
Save favorites, owned products, routines and looks in your Korlix account collection. Explore lip colors, finishes and lash styles in the illustrated look studio. The studio does not scan your face or provide a selfie try-on.

ASK ESHA
Live AI consultations require the consultation service to be available and remaining allowance. The included trial and monthly consultation counts are shown before purchase. Before sending a question, you choose whether Korlix and OpenAI may process it and your recent conversation. Sharing saved beauty preferences is a separate choice. You can withdraw permission for future requests and report an answer. Using your AI allowance does not lock the other features while your membership remains active and verified.

RESTORE AND MANAGE
Sign in to the Korlix account associated with your purchase and use Restore purchases. App access requires fresh server verification of an active trial or subscription. Connect to reverify when prompted; saved collections are kept if access is paused. Account sign-in and recovery, restore and subscription management, legal information, support and account-deletion requests remain available without an active subscription.

The subscription renews automatically unless canceled through your App Store account. Cosmetics are purchased separately. Esha membership does not upgrade another Korlix plan. Deleting an account or uninstalling Esha does not cancel store renewals.

Esha offers cosmetic guidance. It does not diagnose conditions, provide medical treatment or guarantee an exact shade match. Check current product details before buying.
